# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald are delighted to bring 7 Railway Avenue to the market, a charming red brick mid-terrace residence ideally positioned on a quiet and highly sought-after street in the heart of Inchicore. Extending to approximately 60 sq.m. / 646 sq.ft.

- Lokalita: 7 Railway Avenue, Inchicore
